svg.aria-label: Server coordinates, one GPU worker transcodes: 1. Server: The Tdarr server serves the web UI on 8265 and runs the flows. Its database and flow state sit on the tdarr-config claim. 2. Worker: One tdarr-node pod requests devic.es/b70-vaapi, the card on talos-3, and runs two GPU transcode jobs and one CPU job. 3. Transcode: Workers read the NAS media share and write intermediates to the tdarr-temp RWX claim, so large files stay off the node disk. 4. Remote: tdarr-node-lb exposes port 8266 on the LAN, so a GPU node outside the cluster joins the same server. 5. Keep: kopiur snapshots the tdarr-config claim to R2 each day. The temp claim is scratch and is not backed up.
